anchor.note: Logarithms and exponentials, covered by the single-variable calculus item of the reader profile; lg is log base 2, also listed as an alias of the known concept Logarithm and exponential function.
Asymptotic bookkeeping covered by the reader profile (big-O with Omega and Theta, and limits); little-o is also a known concept, Big-Omega, big-Theta and little-o notation.

gaps.term: Bound for one fixed-tape machine transferred to all multitape machines
gaps.quote: so a bound for such a machine is a bound for multitape machines
gaps.note: The page asserts that a time bound for a machine with a fixed number of tapes is a bound for multitape machines, but it does not say why a bound for one such machine constrains every multitape machine, or which quantifier over machines is meant. The later claim that a power saving undercuts the conjecture depends on this step.

gaps.term: Single algorithm for all input lengths
gaps.quote: one algorithm achieves the same saving for every input length
gaps.note: The page presents this as following from kappa being fixed. A fixed exponent does not by itself give one algorithm that works at every input length; the reader cannot check that inference from the page, and the page does not show the construction or cite it as an algorithm's property.
